## Summary

Describe the change and which subsystem it affects (`context`, `verification`, `failure`, `memory`, `adapters`, `cli`, or `benchmarks`).

## Verification Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes with zero errors
- [ ] `npm test` passes all 10 automated test suites
- [ ] Existing user configuration is preserved on `init`, `mode`, and `uninstall`
- [ ] Any performance or token-reduction claim is backed by reproducible benchmark output
